svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Uh oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it ◆ Fusion startups are giving the government shares in exchange for awards. Is it worth it? ◆ This startup’s self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding ◆ Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked ◆ SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo ◆ Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees ◆
